comment: Demo data generated for a college project. Verify against official sources before any real use.

symptoms.name: Fever
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a physician immediately if body temperature exceeds 102°F or persists for more than 3 days.

symptoms.name: Headache
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek immediate emergency care if headache is sudden, explosive, or accompanied by confusion or stiff neck.

symptoms.name: Cold & Runny Nose
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a doctor if nasal congestion is accompanied by severe facial swelling or persistent green discharge.

symptoms.name: Dry Cough
symptoms.red_flag_advice: See a doctor if dry cough lasts more than 2 weeks, disrupts sleep severely, or causes chest tightness.

symptoms.name: Wet Cough
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a physician if phlegm is rusty, blood-stained, or accompanied by breathing difficulty.

symptoms.name: Sore Throat
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek medical evaluation if severe throat pain makes swallowing fluids difficult or lasts beyond 5 days.

symptoms.name: Acidity & Heartburn
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a gastroenterologist if heartburn is accompanied by difficulty swallowing or radiating chest discomfort.

symptoms.name: Indigestion & Gas
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek urgent medical attention if abdominal discomfort radiates to the jaw, neck, or left arm.

symptoms.name: Constipation
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a doctor if constipation persists over 7 days or is accompanied by severe abdominal cramping and vomiting.

symptoms.name: Diarrhoea
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek immediate hospital care if stools contain blood or if signs of severe dehydration (sunken eyes, dizziness) appear.

symptoms.name: Nausea & Vomiting
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a doctor if you cannot retain fluids for over 24 hours, vomit dark coffee-ground material, or feel faint.

symptoms.name: Body Pain & Fatigue
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a physician if generalised aches are accompanied by unexplained weight loss or sudden motor weakness.

symptoms.name: Back Pain
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek urgent care if back pain is associated with numbness in limbs, loss of bowel/bladder control, or fever.

symptoms.name: Joint Pain & Arthritis
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a rheumatologist if joints become red, hot, visibly swollen, or accompanied by morning stiffness over an hour.

symptoms.name: Allergy & Sneezing
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek emergency medical assistance immediately if facial swelling, lip numbness, or breathing wheezes occur.

symptoms.name: Itching & Pruritus
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a dermatologist if itching is full-body, prevents sleep, or is accompanied by jaundice (yellowing skin/eyes).

symptoms.name: Skin Rash & Eczema
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek immediate attention if rash spreads rapidly, forms blisters, or is accompanied by fever or peeling skin.

symptoms.name: Insomnia & Sleeplessness
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a sleep specialist if chronic insomnia impairs daytime cognitive function or causes memory impairment.

symptoms.name: Anxiety & Stress
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek mental healthcare if anxiety induces severe palpitations, unmanageable panic episodes, or depressive thoughts.

symptoms.name: Toothache & Gum Pain
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a dental surgeon urgently if swelling extends to the cheek, jawline, or eye socket with fever.

symptoms.name: Menstrual Cramps
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a gynaecologist if dysmenorrhea is debilitating, prevents daily activities, or accompanied by abnormal heavy bleeding.

symptoms.name: Minor Cuts & Wounds
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek medical dressing if wound is deep, gaping, bleeding heavily, or caused by rusty metal (tetanus risk).

symptoms.name: Eye Irritation & Redness
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult an ophthalmologist promptly if you experience severe eye pain, foreign body sensation, or vision blurring.

symptoms.name: Vitamin Deficiency
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Get a comprehensive blood workup and consult a physician if fatigue is persistent, with brittle nails or mouth sores.

symptoms.name: Fungal Infection
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a doctor if ringworm or fungal patches spread rapidly or do not respond to 2 weeks of topical antifungal therapy.

symptoms.name: Mouth Ulcers
symptoms.red_flag_advice: See a dentist or ENT specialist if oral ulcers do not heal within 14 days or bleed without provocation.

symptoms.name: Muscle Spasms & Cramps
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Seek medical evaluation if muscle spasms are accompanied by extreme dehydration, tingling, or heat stroke symptoms.

symptoms.name: Motion Sickness
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a physician if dizziness or vestibular nausea persists long after travel concludes.

symptoms.name: Dry Eyes & Strain
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult an eye specialist if gritty ocular dryness causes severe light sensitivity or corneal abrasions.

symptoms.name: Ear Pain & Blockage
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult an ENT doctor if earache is accompanied by foul-smelling discharge, sudden hearing reduction, or dizziness.

symptoms.name: Piles & Haemorrhoids
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a surgeon immediately if you experience significant bright red rectal bleeding or severe throbbing perianal pain.

symptoms.name: Hair Fall & Dandruff
symptoms.red_flag_advice: Consult a dermatologist if hair shedding is patchy (alopecia areata) or scalp is inflamed, weeping, and tender.
